description: This Java source file defines a custom Akka mailbox implementation ('ThingPersistenceActorMailbox') used to manage message queuing for 'ThingPersistenceActor' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It primarily handles the enqueuing of 'ThingModifyCommand' messages with capacity-based rejection logic, and incorporates Akka’s mailbox and queue interfaces.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActorMailbox
classes.description: Custom Akka mailbox implementation managing the queuing of 'ThingModifyCommand' messages with capacity restrictions; creates message queues configured with a specified capacity.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActorMailbox.ThingPersistenceActorMessageQueue
classes.description: Inner class implementing a specialized message queue that enforces capacity-based rejection for specific message types and integrates with Akka's mailbox infrastructure.

methods.name: ThingPersistenceActorMailbox
methods.description: Constructor initializing mailbox with configuration-based capacity.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new message queue for the mailbox.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Returns the underlying deque of messages.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues messages; applies special handling for 'ThingModifyCommand' based on capacity.

methods.name: enqueueFirst
methods.description: Enqueues messages at the front of the queue with special handling for 'ThingModifyCommand'.

methods.name: queueSizeBasedAction
methods.description: Checks queue size for capacity and either rejects 'ThingModifyCommand' or runs the provided enqueue action.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the next message from the queue.

methods.name: numberOfMessages
methods.description: Returns current message count in the queue.

methods.name: hasMessages
methods.description: Checks if the queue is not empty.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Transfers remaining messages to dead letter queue during mailbox shutdown.
